prompt: Use the $requirement-traceability-analysis skill to build bidirectional mappings from requirements to artifacts and back, separating coverage status from execution evidence.

Requirement REQ-20 has acceptance criteria, code, and a test name but no run identity or raw log. Identify orphan items, relationship types, coverage statuses, and missing evidence without treating a report's passed claim as executed.

During a release change review, use coverage analysis mode to trace stable IDs, versions, environments, and execution records downstream and upstream across requirements, acceptance, design, code, tests, defects, and CI evidence, returning a TC-## coverage view, auditable gaps, and close conditions.
Run the existing test suite and summarize the CI result.
